raw:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "Physical domain outline, dimensions, and aspect ratio",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Sec. 7.1.1 delegates the domain to Fig. 6(a). Sec. 5 specifies 100×100 elements, which does not establish physical dimensions or square elements. Below, W and H denote width and height, with origin at the lower-left corner.",
      "readings": [
        "Filled square: W=H=1 length unit",
        "Filled rectangle: W=2, H=1 length unit",
        "Filled rectangle: W=3, H=1 length unit"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "Full-domain versus symmetry-reduced representation",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "The reference to Fig. 6(a) does not reveal whether the 100×100 grid represents the whole structure or a symmetry-reduced portion.",
      "readings": [
        "The grid represents the entire beam span W",
        "The grid represents half a beam whose full span is 2W, with a symmetry boundary at midspan"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "support_location_extent",
      "entity": "Locations, number, and spans of support sets",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Sec. 7.1.1 assigns the boundary conditions to Fig. 6(a); no support coordinates or supported lengths appear in the text.",
      "readings": [
        "Support only the nodes at (0,0) and (W,0)",
        "Support bottom-edge patches x/W∈[0,0.02] and x/W∈[0.98,1]",
        "Support the entire left edge and the lower-right corner"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "support_type",
      "entity": "Displacement components restrained at supports",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "The boundary-condition reference in Sec. 7.1.1 does not identify pins, rollers, clamps, or symmetry restraints.",
      "readings": [
        "Lower-left pin: ux=uy=0; lower-right vertical roller: uy=0",
        "Both lower corners pinned: ux=uy=0 at each",
        "Symmetry restraint ux=0 along the left edge, with uy=0 at the lower-right corner"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_position",
      "entity": "Location of the mid-load",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "The name 'mid-load' and the reference to Fig. 6(a) in Sec. 7.1.1 do not establish which midpoint or coordinate is loaded.",
      "readings": [
        "Top-edge midpoint: (W/2,H)",
        "Bottom-edge midpoint: (W/2,0)",
        "Right-edge midpoint: (W,H/2)",
        "Domain center: (W/2,H/2)",
        "Top node on a midspan symmetry cut: (0,H)"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_extent_distribution",
      "entity": "Spatial distribution and finite-element application of the load",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Secs. 4.1 and 7.1.1 establish a constant load but do not specify a point force, load patch, traction profile, or nodal distribution.",
      "readings": [
        "Apply the entire resultant to one node",
        "Split the resultant equally between two adjacent boundary nodes",
        "Apply uniform traction over a centered patch occupying 2% of the loaded edge length"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_direction",
      "entity": "Orientation of the applied force",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 says the direction remains constant during optimization, but its orientation is only referred to Fig. 6(a).",
      "readings": [
        "Vertically downward: (Fx,Fy)=(0,-F)",
        "Horizontally rightward: (Fx,Fy)=(F,0)",
        "Downward and rightward at 45 degrees: (Fx,Fy)=(F/√2,-F/√2)"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_magnitude",
      "entity": "Total applied force resultant",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No numerical force or traction magnitude is supplied for the mid-load problem in Secs. 4.1, 5, or 7.1.1.",
      "readings": [
        "F=1 in consistent force units",
        "F=100 in the same force units"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "passive_region",
      "entity": "Fixed-solid and fixed-void element masks",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4 gives general density bounds, but no passage identifies whether the mid-load example has non-design material, bearing pads, load pads, or prescribed voids.",
      "readings": [
        "All 10000 elements are designable; no passive regions",
        "Fix 2×2-element solid pads adjoining the load and support locations",
        "Prescribe a 10×10-element void patch at the upper-right corner"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Solid Young's modulus scale E1",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eq. (3) defines E1 symbolically but supplies no numerical value. This item concerns uniform stiffness scaling with E0/E1 held fixed.",
      "readings": [
        "E1=1 in normalized stiffness units",
        "E1=210 GPa, with the same E0/E1 ratio"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Void stiffness and solid-to-void contrast",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eq. (3) introduces E0 but never specifies its value or its ratio to E1.",
      "readings": [
        "E0/E1=10^-9",
        "E0/E1=10^-6",
        "E0/E1=10^-3"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Poisson's ratio",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4 specifies Young's-modulus interpolation but gives no Poisson's ratio for the elastic constitutive matrix.",
      "readings": [
        "Constant ν=0.20",
        "Constant ν=0.30",
        "Constant ν=0.45"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Two-dimensional constitutive assumption",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4 specifies bilinear quadrilateral elements without stating whether their elasticity formulation uses plane stress or plane strain.",
      "readings": [
        "Plane stress",
        "Plane strain"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Uniform out-of-plane thickness",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No thickness is stated for the quadrilateral-element model. With a fixed force resultant and volume fraction, uniform thickness changes compliance scaling.",
      "readings": [
        "Uniform thickness t=1 length unit",
        "Uniform thickness t=0.1 length unit"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Operational definition of the filter selected by ft=1",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 5 supplies ft=1 and rmin=2.4 but does not reproduce the filter operation, weighting kernel, or low-density regularization needed to translate that switch to another solver.",
      "readings": [
        "Density-weighted sensitivity filtering with conical weights H_ij=max(0,2.4-d_ij) and denominator density floor 10^-3",
        "The same sensitivity filter with denominator density floor 10^-6",
        "Normalized conical density averaging, with sensitivities differentiated through the averaging",
        "Sensitivity filtering with uniform weights inside radius 2.4 and denominator density floor 10^-3"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Units and distance metric for rmin=2.4",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 5 fixes the numerical radius but does not state its units or how distances relate to physical element dimensions.",
      "readings": [
        "Euclidean distance in row/column index coordinates; radius 2.4 element pitches",
        "Physical Euclidean radius equal to 2.4 times the smaller element dimension",
        "Physical Euclidean radius of 2.4 length units; for W=10 units this is 0.24W"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Filter treatment at domain boundaries and passive cells",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 5 does not describe filter extension, normalization near boundaries, or participation of any passive cells.",
      "readings": [
        "Truncate neighborhoods at physical boundaries, renormalize surviving weights, and include passive cells",
        "Truncate and renormalize neighborhoods while excluding passive cells",
        "Reflect fields across a symmetry cut and truncate/renormalize at other boundaries",
        "Zero-pad outside the domain and retain full-kernel normalization"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Initial density field and initialization between volume-fraction runs",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Secs. 5 and 7.1.1 describe varying volume fraction but do not state whether each optimization starts independently or continues from a preceding solution.",
      "readings": [
        "Start the Fig. 8 run with uniform density ρ=0.25",
        "Start with ρ=0.20 in the left half and ρ=0.30 in the right half",
        "Warm-start from the converged volume-fraction-0.24 design"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Optimization update rule and numerical update controls",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 names top88, but the supplied text does not give its update equations, move limit, damping, or multiplier-search tolerance.",
      "readings": [
        "Optimality-criteria updates with move limit 0.2, square-root damping, and relative multiplier-search tolerance 10^-3",
        "Optimality-criteria updates with move limit 0.05, square-root damping, and relative multiplier-search tolerance 10^-6",
        "MMA updates with maximum density change 0.1 per iteration"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Topology-optimization stopping criterion and iteration cap",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No termination settings are stated for the mid-load top88 runs. Sec. 5 assigns maxit=100 to TOPress, while the 2000 epochs in Sec. 7.1.1 concern CNN training.",
      "readings": [
        "Stop when maximum density change is below 0.01, with a 500-iteration cap",
        "Stop when maximum density change is below 0.001, with a 1000-iteration cap",
        "Perform exactly 100 optimization iterations"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    }
  ]
}
